item.description:
notes

(i think that our cat is a guardian angel for my son. it came on Christmas eve, with snow on the roof. it brought him out from his misery and gave him a companion who is just not able to speak.)

  • Book: Further Along the Road Less Traveled: The Unending Journey Towards Spiritual Growth by M. Scott Peck

  • constrained but not powerless from metafilter

So the gist is that we do not have free will and we are not free agents. However we have constrained and limited agency.
